projects.title: Hello Regtest
projects.description: Spin up bitcoind in regtest, mine your first blocks, fund a wallet, and print a confirmed balance with Core RPC.

projects.title: Raw Transaction Decoder
projects.description: Parse hex transactions into inputs, outputs, locktime, and witness data. Support legacy and SegWit formats.

projects.title: BIP-21 Payment URI Tool
projects.description: Build and parse bitcoin: URIs with amount, label, and message. Generate QR codes merchants can scan.

projects.title: Address Format Lab
projects.description: Generate and validate P2PKH, P2WPKH, P2SH-P2WPKH, and P2TR addresses from the same key material. Explain each encoding.

projects.title: Mempool Fee Thermometer
projects.description: Poll fee estimates and mempool size, then chart next-block vs economy rates so users pick a sensible feerate.

projects.title: Bitcoin Script Puzzle Kit
projects.description: Solve and author locking scripts with OP_IF, hash locks, and timelocks. Verify spends on regtest.

projects.title: Coin Selection Playground
projects.description: Implement largest-first and branch-and-bound style selection. Visualize waste, change, and fee tradeoffs on a fixed UTXO set.

projects.title: Block Header Inspector
projects.description: Decode block headers, verify proof-of-work targets, and walk merkle proofs for a chosen transaction.

projects.title: BOLT11 Invoice Decoder
projects.description: Decode Lightning invoices into amount, payment hash, expiry, route hints, and feature bits. Round-trip encode a test invoice.

projects.title: LNURL-Withdraw Kiosk
projects.description: Implement a tiny LNURL-withdraw endpoint that hands out small testnet payments from a pre-funded node.

projects.title: Regtest CLI Wallet
projects.description: Ship a descriptor-based CLI that creates addresses, tracks UTXOs, builds change outputs, and broadcasts signed spends on regtest.

projects.title: Regtest Block Explorer
projects.description: Index recent blocks and txs for a private chain. Pages for block, tx, and address with mempool pending list.

projects.title: HD Seed & Descriptor Backup
projects.description: Create BIP39 seeds, derive BIP84/86 accounts, export output descriptors, and restore a wallet from backup alone.

projects.title: 2-of-3 PSBT Signing Desk
projects.description: Coordinate a 2-of-3 spend across three keyholders with PSBT create, update, combine, and finalize steps.

projects.title: RBF & CPFP Fee Lab
projects.description: Stuck tx toolkit: bump with BIP-125 RBF or child-pays-for-parent, and prove both paths on regtest mempool policy.

projects.title: Miniscript Policy Studio
projects.description: Compile spending policies to Miniscript and descriptors. Show satisfaction cost and Taproot tree layouts.

projects.title: P2P Message Sniffer
projects.description: Connect as a lightweight peer, log inv/tx/block messages, and visualize gossip for a few minutes of traffic.

projects.title: Watch-Only Portfolio Tracker
projects.description: Import xpubs/descriptors, sync balances without private keys, and label UTXOs across multiple accounts.

projects.title: Lightning Tip Jar
projects.description: Static tip page that mints fresh BOLT11 invoices per visitor, shows QR, and marks paid via hold invoice or settle webhook.

projects.title: Channel Balance Board
projects.description: List open channels with local/remote balance ratios, fee policies, and a rebalance suggestion when skewed.

projects.title: Keysend Messenger
projects.description: Send and receive spontaneous keysend payments with a tiny TLV payload for chat-like demos on testnet.

projects.title: BOLT12 Offers Checkout
projects.description: Reusable offer that yields invoices on demand. Support amountless offers and onion message replies where your stack allows.

projects.title: Good First Issue Radar
projects.description: Crawl labeled issues across Bitcoin/Lightning orgs, score by language match and freshness, and export a weekly shortlist.

projects.title: bitcoind Ops Console
projects.description: Live panels for IBD progress, peer counts, mempool bytes, and fee estimates. Never expose RPC to the browser.

projects.title: On-chain Payment Processor
projects.description: Merchant API for unique deposit addresses, confirmation policies, idempotent invoices, and signed settlement webhooks.

projects.title: Taproot Inheritance Vault
projects.description: Key-path spend for normal use, script-path CSV inheritance branch for heirs. Document recovery drills on regtest.

projects.title: Compact Block Relay Lab
projects.description: Simulate BIP152 compact block reconstruction: short IDs, mempool prefill, and fallback getblocktxn paths.

projects.title: Lightning Retail POS
projects.description: Cashier flow: cart total → invoice QR → settle/expire. Idempotent tickets so refreshes never double-charge.

projects.title: Lightning Routing Ops Desk
projects.description: Channel health, forwarding history, fee revenue, offline peers, and alerts for forced closes.

projects.title: Mission-Control Style Router
projects.description: Score graph edges with fees, CLTV, and historical failures. Benchmark success rate against a naive Dijkstra baseline.

projects.title: Channel Splice Simulator
projects.description: Model dual-funding and splicing state machines: add/remove capacity without full close, including failure rollbacks.

projects.title: Watchtower Client Lab
projects.description: Register sessions, upload encrypted blobs, and verify a tower publishes justice txs when a revoked commit appears.

projects.title: Multipath Payment Harness
projects.description: Split payments across paths under a fee budget. Log partial failures and atomic success against AMP/MPP-capable peers.

projects.title: Cashu Mint Toy
projects.description: Educational Cashu mint that issues and melts blinded tokens backed by a Lightning node. Not for mainnet funds.

projects.title: Bitcoin Core PR Lab
projects.description: Reproduce a good-first or docs/tests issue against Core, write a focused patch with functional tests, and document review notes.
